basic_profile.bio: An avid gamer hailing from Dhaka, Bangladesh, I've been exploring the world of Reddit for a year and a half. My passion lies in strategy games like Illusion Connect and Plants vs Zombies Heroes. I work as a software developer during the day, which fuels my interest in tech-related subreddits. I usually browse Reddit during my commutes and late at night after work. I'm currently single and enjoy discussing game strategies and hypothetical scenarios. I dislike unnecessary game mechanics that disrupt the flow of gameplay.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science, with a degree from a local university. My expertise in gaming strategies is self-taught, honed over years of playing and analyzing different games. My job as a software developer also keeps me updated on the latest in technology.
